messages:
Carlos (Acme): Hey, noticed a spike of 504s in our logs when we cancel user requests client-side. Using go-sdk v0.9.3 + our own http.Client. Happens mostly when users abort long streaming responses.
Alicia (Support): Can you paste a minimal repro and any relevant logs?
Carlos (Acme): Repro below. We call Redwood client with a context that we cancel on user disconnect. About ~30% of the time the SDK retries and we see a downstream 504 from the model endpoint. Logs show 'context canceled' but then a retry immediately after.
Carlos (Acme): ```go
// simplified
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(req.Context(), 25*time.Second)
defer cancel()

httpClient := &http.Client{ // our app-wide client
  Timeout: 0, // we rely on context
  Transport: &http.Transport{
    MaxIdleConns: 100,
    IdleConnTimeout: 90 * time.Second,
  },
}

client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{HTTPClient: httpClient})
_, err := client.Generate(ctx, ...) // streaming call
if err != nil { log.Printf("gen err=%v", err) }
```
Carlos (Acme): Sample logs (truncated):
```
2026-08-03T12:34:18Z request_id=abc start
2026-08-03T12:34:42Z request_id=abc user_conn_closed -> ctx canceled
2026-08-03T12:34:42Z request_id=abc sdk: got error: context canceled
2026-08-03T12:34:42Z request_id=abc sdk: retrying attempt=2
2026-08-03T12:34:43Z request_id=abc downstream: 504 gateway timeout
```
Alicia (Support): Hmm. So SDK is seeing context canceled but still scheduling a retry. That looks like SDK retry policy treating errors as transient without checking ctx.Err().
Ben (Eng-Oncall): This rings a bell — older go-sdk versions had a bug where context.Canceled/DeadlineExceeded were wrapped and treated as retryable. Which SDK version again?
Carlos (Acme): v0.9.3 (we pinned).
Emily (DevEx): Quick workaround: set RetryConfig.MaxRetries = 0 for streaming routes or add a retry predicate that returns false when ctx.Err()!=nil. Example: `RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry = func(err error, attempt int) bool { return ctx.Err()==nil && isTransient(err) }`
Alicia (Support): Can you try one quick experiment: disable SDK retries and see if the 504s disappear (should fail faster but avoid duplicate downstream calls). Also try setting http.Client.Timeout to a small value vs relying solely on ctx cancel to observe behavior.
Carlos (Acme): I tried disabling retries locally — immediate fix: no duplicate calls and 504s drop to baseline. But streaming UX suffered (we want best-effort reconnects).
Ben (Eng-Oncall): Long-term fix: SDK should never retry on errors that are caused by the request context being canceled. I'll open an eng issue. In the meantime, recommended options: (1) upgrade to go-sdk >= v0.10.1 (contains ctx-aware retry fix), or (2) add a retry predicate that checks for context cancellation, or (3) set `http.Client.Timeout` to a non-zero value and let the client-level timeout surface as DeadlineExceeded (but careful: that changes semantics).
Emily (DevEx): Patch snippet we recommend for workaround if you can't upgrade yet:
```go
// wrap the SDK retry predicate
orig := sdk.DefaultRetryPredicate
wrapped := func(err error, attempt int) bool {
    // if context already canceled, don't retry
    if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
        return false
    }
    return orig(err, attempt)
}
cfg.RetryPredicate = wrapped
```
Alicia (Support): Also note: avoid mixing http.Client.Timeout==0 with context cancel if you rely on SDK for retry semantics; some transports return different error types depending on whether net/http timed out vs context canceled. That affects predicate matching.
Carlos (Acme): Thanks — we'll test upgrade and the predicate. One more oddity: some traces show the retry occurring within <100ms after cancel. Is that a race where request goroutine returns error but retry scheduler doesn't re-check ctx?
Ben (Eng-Oncall): Yes likely. The fix in v0.10.1 defers re-evaluating ctx.Err() immediately before scheduling the retry and treats wrapped errors from transport as non-retryable when ctx shows cancel. That stops the immediate retry.
Carlos (Acme): Ok testing now. Any recommended telemetry to add?
Emily (DevEx): Add a metric: sdk.retry_skipped_due_to_ctx_cancel and log original request_id + attempt. Also log the root cause error string and whether ctx.Err()!=nil at the time of deciding to retry. Helps confirm fix.
retry-bot: A new issue has been filed: RED-3051 "go-sdk: avoid retries when ctx canceled" by Ben. Priority P2.
Alicia (Support): Follow-up in 24h? Carlos, please report results and we'll keep support loop open. :thumbsup:
Carlos (Acme): Will do, thanks!
